title: Sunday · Wagner's, empty
logline: The hardware store's windows a month after closing: bare shelves, the thank-you sign, the reflection of the street. The strip's only Sunday on the subject.

panels.composition: Tier 1: Wagner's Hardware's storefront, the windows empty, the sign in one: THANK YOU SMALL WOOD 1962–2011. The street reflected over the bare shelves inside.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, an empty hardware store's front windows with a hand-lettered farewell sign in one and bare shelves inside, the street reflected in the glass, no words
image.notes: THANK YOU SMALL WOOD 1962–2011, letter after.

panels.name: Windows

panels.composition: Tier 2: inside, through the glass: the shelves, the price-tag rails, one bin of nails nobody took.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, bare hardware-store shelves seen through a window with one forgotten bin of nails, no words

panels.name: Shelves

panels.composition: Tier 3: the corner from across the street, the store dark, the Lanes' sign on the hill behind with its one letter out. Held.

panels.name: Corner

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: Wagner's as a Sunday. The nails nobody took.
